title: Chaining through *this
prompt: Implement `class Ledger` with private `long total_{0};`, `Ledger& add(long cents)` and `Ledger& undo(long cents)` (each updates `total_` and returns `*this`), plus `long total() const`. The test chains calls.

tests.name: chain
tests.hint: Each call returns the same object → chaining works.

tests.name: single
tests.hint: Single calls behave like plain mutators.
